verdict.rationale: Secureframe is a compliance SaaS platform, so outbound webhooks are a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence documents only an inbound REST API, an MCP server, email alerts, Jira/Slack task notifications and an in-app Notifications Hub. None of these are registrable outbound HTTP callbacks, so the evidence does not show webhook support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
